scope: Nine explicitly named native source files. Count only own public methods, implemented Python dunders, public classes, StdClass.RESERVED, exported MISSING and ten metadata constants. The private sentinel implementation class is tracked explicitly because its two dunders define the exported marker's behavior. Contract declarations, curated exports, Container integration, private helpers, private state, inherited stdlib behavior and native test declarations are separate and never inflate the own-method total.
